classification.difficultyReason: Translate fixed height and volume into a base product and enumerate every positive integer factor pair, excluding the supplied cube and duplicate rotations.

content.prompt: A litre. We wish to build a rectangular prism of height 10 cm and volume $1000\text{ cm}^3$ (=1 L). All dimensions are to be integer numbers of centimetres. One such container is a cube with edges 10 cm long. Find all the others.

answer.short: Other base dimensions, in centimetres: $1\times100$, $2\times50$, $4\times25$, $5\times20$. Height 10 cm; base order may be swapped.
answer.worked: If the base sides are $l$ and $w$, then $10lw=1000$, so $lw=100$. The positive factor pairs are $(1,100),(2,50),(4,25),(5,20),(10,10)$. The last is the supplied cube; the other four are all possibilities, each with height 10 cm. Swapping the two base sides gives the same dimensions.
